title.en: Law of chemical equilibrium and equilibrium constants
title.kn: ರಾಸಾಯನಿಕ ಸಮತೋಲನದ ನಿಯಮ ಮತ್ತು ಸಮತೋಲನ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ

heading.en: Can one number describe a whole equilibrium?

hook.en: Start with any amounts of hydrogen and iodine at a fixed temperature, and one ratio of concentrations always comes out the same. That number is the *equilibrium* constant.
hook.kn: ಸ್ಥಿರ ತಾಪದಲ್ಲಿ ಹೈಡ್ರೋಜನ್ ಮತ್ತು ಅಯೋಡಿನ್ ಎಷ್ಟೇ ಪ್ರಮಾಣದಲ್ಲಿ ತೆಗೆದುಕೊಂಡರೂ ಸಾರತೆಗಳ ಒಂದು ಅನುಪಾತ ಒಂದೇ ಆಗಿರುತ್ತದೆ. ಆ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆಯೇ ಸಮತೋಲನ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ.

title.en: Write Kc and Kp for a reaction
Relate Kp and Kc using Δn

say.en: Start with any amounts of hydrogen and iodine at a fixed temperature, and one ratio of concentrations always comes out the same. That number is the equilibrium constant. In this lesson: Write Kc and Kp for a reaction.
Relate Kp and Kc using delta n.
Handle heterogeneous equilibria.

body.en: For aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD, the law of chemical *equilibrium* (Guldberg and Waage) gives $K_c = [C]^c[D]^d/[A]^a[B]^b$ at a fixed temperature. If the equation is reversed, K becomes 1/K; if it is multiplied by n, K becomes $K^n$.
body.kn: aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ ಸ್ಥಿರ ತಾಪದಲ್ಲಿ Kc = [C]^c[D]^d / [A]^a[B]^b. ಸಮೀಕರಣ ತಿರುಗಿಸಿದರೆ K ಯು 1/K ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.

narration.en: For aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD, the law of chemical equilibrium (Guldberg and Waage) gives Kc = [C]^c[D]^d/[A]^a[B]^b at a fixed temperature. If the equation is reversed, K becomes 1/K; if it is multiplied by n, K becomes K^n.
narration.kn: aA + bB ⇌ cC + dD ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ ಸ್ಥಿರ ತಾಪದಲ್ಲಿ Kc = [C]^c[D]^d / [A]^a[B]^b. ಸಮೀಕರಣ ತಿರುಗಿಸಿದರೆ K ಯು 1/K ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: For aA plus bB is in equilibrium with cC plus dD, the law of chemical equilibrium Guldberg and Waage gives Kc = [C]^c[D]^d/[A]^a[B]^b at a fixed temperature. If the equation is reversed, K becomes 1 over K; if it is multiplied by n, K becomes K^n. Kc depends only on temperature.
say.kn: aA plus bB is in equilibrium with cC plus dD ಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೆ ಸ್ಥಿರ ತಾಪದಲ್ಲಿ Kc = [C]^c[D]^d / [A]^a[B]^b. ಸಮೀಕರಣ ತಿರುಗಿಸಿದರೆ K ಯು 1 over K ಆಗುತ್ತದೆ.

say.en: Reverse reaction: K′ = 1 over K.
Equation times n: K′ = K to the power n.
For a balanced equation, K is products over reactants, each concentration raised to its coefficient.
Reverse the equation and K becomes one over K. Multiply the equation by n and K becomes K to the power n.
For gases, partial pressure p equals c R T, so Kp equals Kc times R T to the power delta n, the change in gas moles. For N2O4 going to 2 NO2, delta n is 1.
In a heterogeneous equilibrium, pure solids and liquids are left out. For limestone, Kp is simply the pressure of carbon dioxide.
Writing and using equilibrium constants.

narration.en: A ⇌ B with forward rate constant kf and backward kb. Start with pure A or pure B: the concentrations level off at the same values, where Q = [B]/[A] equals K = kf/kb.
narration.kn: A ⇌ B ಮುಂದಿನ ದರ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ kf, ಹಿಂದಿನ kb. ಶುದ್ಧ A ಅಥವಾ ಶುದ್ಧ B ಯಿಂದ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಿ: ಸಾರತೆಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ಮೌಲ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಬರುತ್ತವೆ, ಅಲ್ಲಿ Q = K = kf/kb.

caption.en: A ⇌ B with forward rate constant kf and backward kb. Start with pure A or pure B: the concentrations level off at the same values, where Q = [B]/[A] equals K = kf/kb.
caption.kn: A ⇌ B ಮುಂದಿನ ದರ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ kf, ಹಿಂದಿನ kb. ಶುದ್ಧ A ಅಥವಾ ಶುದ್ಧ B ಯಿಂದ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಿ: ಸಾರತೆಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ಮೌಲ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಬರುತ್ತವೆ, ಅಲ್ಲಿ Q = K = kf/kb.

tryThis.en: Make kf twice kb. What is [B]/[A] at the end?
tryThis.kn: kf ಅನ್ನು kb ಯ ಎರಡರಷ್ಟು ಮಾಡಿ. ಕೊನೆಗೆ [B]/[A] ಎಷ್ಟು?

say.en: A is in equilibrium with B with forward rate constant kf and backward kb. Start with pure A or pure B: the concentrations level off at the same values, where Q = [B]/[A] equals K equals kf over kb.
say.kn: A is in equilibrium with B ಮುಂದಿನ ದರ ಸ್ಥಿರಾಂಕ kf, ಹಿಂದಿನ kb. ಶುದ್ಧ A ಅಥವಾ ಶುದ್ಧ B ಯಿಂದ ಪ್ರಾರಂಭಿಸಿ: ಸಾರತೆಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ಮೌಲ್ಯಕ್ಕೆ ಬರುತ್ತವೆ, ಅಲ್ಲಿ Q equals K equals kf over kb.

body.en: For gases we may use partial pressures: $K_p = K_c(RT)^{\Delta n}$, where Δn is moles of gaseous products minus moles of gaseous reactants. In a *heterogeneous* equilibrium, pure solids and pure liquids are left out, so for CaCO₃(s) ⇌ CaO(s) + CO₂(g), $K_p = p_{CO_2}$.
body.kn: ಅನಿಲಗಳಿಗೆ Kp = Kc(RT)^Δn; Δn = ಅನಿಲ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನಗಳ ಮೋಲ್ − ಅನಿಲ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಕಾರಿಗಳ ಮೋಲ್. ಭಿನ್ನಜಾತೀಯ ಸಮತೋಲನದಲ್ಲಿ ಶುದ್ಧ ಘನ ಮತ್ತು ದ್ರವಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

points.en: R = 0.0831 L bar mol⁻¹ K⁻¹ when p is in bar
Pure solids and liquids do not appear in K

In a heterogeneous equilibrium, pure solids and pure liquids are left out, so for CaCO 3s is in equilibrium with CaOs plus CO 2g, Kp equals pCO2. delta n equals 0 so Kp equals Kc.
say.kn: ಅನಿಲಗಳಿಗೆ Kp equals KcRT^delta n; delta n equals ಅನಿಲ ಉತ್ಪನ್ನಗಳ ಮೋಲ್ - ಅನಿಲ ಕ್ರಿಯಾಕಾರಿಗಳ ಮೋಲ್. ಭಿನ್ನಜಾತೀಯ ಸಮತೋಲನದಲ್ಲಿ ಶುದ್ಧ ಘನ ಮತ್ತು ದ್ರವಗಳನ್ನು ಬಿಡಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.

problem.en: At equilibrium for H₂(g) + I₂(g) ⇌ 2HI(g), [H₂] = 0.10 M, [I₂] = 0.10 M and [HI] = 0.80 M. Find Kc.

narration.en: Let us solve this together. At equilibrium for H₂(g) + I₂(g) ⇌ 2HI(g), [H₂] = 0.10 M, [I₂] = 0.10 M and [HI] = 0.80 M. Find Kc.

say.en: Let us solve this together. At equilibrium for H 2g plus I 2g is in equilibrium with 2HIg, [H 2] = 0.10 M, [I 2] = 0.10 M and [HI] = 0.80 M. Find Kc.
Kc = [HI] squared / ([H 2][I 2]).
Kc equals 0.80 squared / 0.10 times 0.10 equals 0.64 divided by 0.010.
Kc equals 64.
So the answer is Kc equals 64.

problem.en: For PCl₅(g) ⇌ PCl₃(g) + Cl₂(g), Kc = 0.040 at 500 K. Find Kp (R = 0.0831 L bar mol⁻¹ K⁻¹).

narration.en: Let us solve this together. For PCl₅(g) ⇌ PCl₃(g) + Cl₂(g), Kc = 0.040 at 500 K. Find Kp (R = 0.0831 L bar mol⁻¹ K⁻¹).

say.en: Let us solve this together. For PCl 5g is in equilibrium with PCl 3g plus Cl 2g, Kc equals 0.040 at 500 kelvin. Find Kp (R equals 0.0831 L bar mol to the power minus 1 K to the power minus 1).
delta n equals 1 plus 1 minus 1 equals 1.
Kp equals KcRT to the power 1 equals 0.040 times 0.0831 times 500.
Kp is approximately 1.66.
So the answer is Kp is approximately 1.66 bar.

heading.en: Kp or Kc? Count gas moles

body.en: Count only gaseous moles. If Δn = 0, Kp = Kc. If Δn is positive, Kp > Kc (when RT > 1); if negative, Kp < Kc.
